title: homogenize — predisposition

sentences.sentence: plans to homogenize the various school systems
sentences.translation: 统一各类不同学制的计划

phrases.translation: 美感，审美观念；审美知觉

sentences.sentence: From an esthetic point of view, it’s a nice design.
sentences.translation: 从美学角度看，这是个不错的设计。

sentences.sentence: a work of great aesthetic appeal
sentences.translation: 极富美之神韵的作品

phrases.translation: 便携设备，手提设备；移动式设备
便携式收音机；便携式无线电台

sentences.sentence: a portable radio
sentences.translation: 便携式收音机

sentences.sentence: I envisioned a future of educational excellence.
sentences.translation: 我展望了一个有着优质教育的未来。

sentences.sentence: It allows you to harness existing technologies and incorporate them into one application.
sentences.translation: 它允许您利用现有的技术并将它们合并到同一个应用程序中。

sentences.sentence: The next step is to generate the report and then incorporate it as an affiliated document of the master document.
sentences.translation: 紧接着的步骤就是产生这个报告，然后将它作为主文档的附属文档与主文档合并。

phrases.translation: 传统基金会；遗产基金会

sentences.sentence: the importance of preserving the national heritage
sentences.translation: 保护民族遗产的重要性

sentences.sentence: beautiful old buildings which are part of our heritage
sentences.translation: 属于我们遗产一部分的漂亮古建筑

sentences.sentence: The book covers a range of areas of second language research including sociolinguistic, psycholinguistic , and linguistic perspectives.
sentences.translation: 这本书涵盖了第二语言的研究，包括社会学，心理语言学和语言的角度等一系列领域。

sentences.sentence: This paper aims at studying bilingual teaching from psycholinguistic perspective by employing some principles in children language acquisition.
sentences.translation: 本文从心理语言学的角度出发，运用儿童母语习得中的部分原理来研究双语教学。

sentences.sentence: Based on the psycholinguistic theory, this paper explores the nature and the phenomena of language deviance, and the constraints of context and cognition on language deviance.
sentences.translation: 本文从心理语言学的理论出发，探析了语言变异的本质、现象以及语境和认知对语言变异的限制。

sentences.sentence: a tacit agreement between the three big companies
sentences.translation: 三家大公司之间的默契

sentences.sentence: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
sentences.translation: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

sentences.sentence: explicit knowledge of grammar
sentences.translation: 清楚易懂的语法知识

sentences.sentence: The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
sentences.translation: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

sentences.sentence: Be explicit when you talk about money with your family.
sentences.translation: 与家人谈钱的问题要直截了当。

sentences.sentence: Television violence can encourage aggression in children.
sentences.translation: 电视暴力会助长儿童的攻击性行为。

phrases.translation: [生]活化石；[口]落后于时代的人

sentences.sentence: fossils of early reptiles
sentences.translation: 早期爬行动物的化石

sentences.sentence: Marine sponges have a long fossil record (= their development has been recorded over a long period ) .
sentences.translation: 海绵动物留下了漫长的化石记录。

sentences.sentence: Her husband was later treated for a fractured skull.
sentences.translation: 她丈夫后来因颅骨碎裂而接受治疗。

sentences.sentence: Every few months, I receive an e-mail from an outraged (usually white) reader who is dismayed by what she sees as the denigration of my work.
sentences.translation: 每隔几个月，我便会收到一封来自愤怒读者（通常是白人）的电子邮件，对于她认为我的作品遭到的诋毁感到愤忾。

sentences.sentence: And outraged, nauseous, flabbergasted ... I wish I could say I can't imagine what they were thinking, but in fact I do have a guess.
sentences.translation: 我感到受了伤害，并且愤怒、恶心、震惊······ 我但愿自己能说无法想像出他们的想法，但事实上我有一个猜想。

sentences.sentence: Greeks have turned out in droves to a series of nationwide protests against the economy and austerity measures, outraged that they are being asked to make more sacrifices.
sentences.translation: 希腊人举行了一系列针对经济状况和紧缩措施的大规模抗议，他们对政府要求自己做出更多牺牲感到愤怒。

sentences.sentence: a bizarre coincidence
sentences.translation: 奇怪的巧合

sentences.sentence: dancers in rather bizarre costumes
sentences.translation: 身着奇装异服的舞者

sentences.sentence: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
sentences.translation: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

sentences.sentence: the current consensus of opinion
sentences.translation: 目前观点上的一致

sentences.sentence: The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
sentences.translation: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

sentences.sentence: the consensus politics of the fifties
sentences.translation: 50年代的共识政治

sentences.sentence: obedience classes for dogs and their owners
sentences.translation: 为狗和主人安排的服从训练课

phrases.translation: 先天与后天，遗传与环境；先天遗传说和后天培养说

sentences.sentence: European union is an ideal that has been nurtured since the post-war years.
sentences.translation: 建立欧盟是战后多年来人们一直争取实现的理想。

sentences.sentence: a hatred of foreigners nurtured by the media
sentences.translation: 由媒体助长的对外国人的仇恨

sentences.sentence: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
sentences.translation: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

sentences.sentence: But in many ways the picture in Washington may be deteriorating.
sentences.translation: 但是在华盛顿，许多方面的情况可能是在恶化。

sentences.sentence: In my point of view, we are in a prime time to curb the problem from deteriorating.
sentences.translation: 我认为，现在已经到了控制这个问题进一步恶化的成熟时机。

sentences.sentence: If you raise the issue of your father's deteriorating health and he changes the subject, you can try to gently raise it again, without pressuring him.
sentences.translation: 如果你向父亲提出了他健康恶化的问题，而他却改变了话题，你可以试着温和的再次把问题提出来，而不要强迫他。

sentences.sentence: There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
sentences.translation: 教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。

text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 10 单元

homogenize
音标：英 /hə'mɒdʒənaɪz/  美 /ho'mɑdʒə,naɪz/
v. 使类同，使一致
例句：plans to homogenize the various school systems
统一各类不同学制的计划

aesthetic
音标：英 /iːs'θetɪk/  美 /ɛs'θɛtɪk/
n&adj. 美学的，审美的
短语：aesthetic education — 美育；审美教育
短语：aesthetic value — 审美价值，美学价值
短语：aesthetic feeling — 美感
短语：aesthetic appreciation — 审美
短语：aesthetic appearance — 式样美观
短语：aesthetic perception — 美感，审美观念；审美知觉
短语：aesthetic quality — 美感质素；感官质量
短语：aesthetic design — 美学设计；美术设计
短语：aesthetic attitude — 审美态度；美感态度
短语：aesthetic pleasure — 审美享受
例句：From an esthetic point of view, it’s a nice design.
从美学角度看，这是个不错的设计。
例句：a work of great aesthetic appeal
极富美之神韵的作品

portable
音标：英 /'pɔːtəb(ə)l/  美 /'pɔrtəbl/
adj. 便携的，手提的
短语：portable computer — 便携式计算机
短语：portable equipment — 便携设备，手提设备；移动式设备
短语：portable type — 便携式
短语：portable water — 饮料水；便携式水
短语：portable system — 可移植系统
短语：portable radio — 便携式收音机；便携式无线电台
短语：portable machine — 轻便机器
短语：portable electronics — 便携式电子设备
例句：a portable radio
便携式收音机

envision
音标：英 /ɪnˈvɪʒn/  美 /ɪn'vɪʒn/
v. 展望，预想
例句：I envisioned a future of educational excellence.
我展望了一个有着优质教育的未来。

incorporate
音标：英 /ɪn'kɔːpəreɪt/
v. 合并；体现
短语：incorporate with — 合并；混合
例句：It allows you to harness existing technologies and incorporate them into one application.
它允许您利用现有的技术并将它们合并到同一个应用程序中。
例句：The next step is to generate the report and then incorporate it as an affiliated document of the master document.
紧接着的步骤就是产生这个报告，然后将它作为主文档的附属文档与主文档合并。

heritage
音标：英 /'herɪtɪdʒ/  美 /'hɛrɪtɪdʒ/
n. 遗产
短语：cultural heritage — 文化遗产
短语：natural heritage — 自然遗产
短语：heritage preservation — 遗产维护
短语：heritage foundation — 传统基金会；遗产基金会
例句：the importance of preserving the national heritage
保护民族遗产的重要性
例句：beautiful old buildings which are part of our heritage
属于我们遗产一部分的漂亮古建筑

psycholinguistic
音标：英 /,psaikəuliŋ'ɡwistik/
n. 心理语言学
例句：The book covers a range of areas of second language research including sociolinguistic, psycholinguistic , and linguistic perspectives.
这本书涵盖了第二语言的研究，包括社会学，心理语言学和语言的角度等一系列领域。
例句：This paper aims at studying bilingual teaching from psycholinguistic perspective by employing some principles in children language acquisition.
本文从心理语言学的角度出发，运用儿童母语习得中的部分原理来研究双语教学。
例句：Based on the psycholinguistic theory, this paper explores the nature and the phenomena of language deviance, and the constraints of context and cognition on language deviance.
本文从心理语言学的理论出发，探析了语言变异的本质、现象以及语境和认知对语言变异的限制。

tacit
音标：英 /'tæsɪt/  美 /'tæsɪt/
adj. 缄默的，心照不宣的
短语：tacit knowledge — 隐性知识；默会知识
短语：tacit understanding — 默契
短语：tacit agreement — 默示协议
短语：tacit cooperation — 配合默契
短语：tacit approval — 默认
例句：a tacit agreement between the three big companies
三家大公司之间的默契

explicit
音标：英 /ɪk'splɪsɪt/  美 /ɪk'splɪsɪt/
adj. 明确的，清楚的；直率的
短语：explicit expression — 显式表达式
短语：explicit knowledge — 显性知识；外显知识
短语：explicit memory — 外显记忆
短语：explicit function — 显函数
短语：explicit formulation — 显式
例句：The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
这个对比再清楚不过了。
例句：explicit knowledge of grammar
清楚易懂的语法知识
例句：The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。
例句：Be explicit when you talk about money with your family.
与家人谈钱的问题要直截了当。

aggression
音标：英 /ə'greʃ(ə)n/  美 /ə'ɡrɛʃən/
n. 攻击；挑衅
短语：physical aggression — 身体攻击
例句：Television violence can encourage aggression in children.
电视暴力会助长儿童的攻击性行为。

fossil
音标：英 /'fɒs(ə)l/  美 /'fɑsl/
n. 化石
短语：fossil fuel — 矿物燃料，化石燃料
短语：living fossil — [生]活化石；[口]落后于时代的人
短语：trace fossil — 生痕化石；踪迹化石
短语：fossil oil — 石油；化石燃料
例句：fossils of early reptiles
早期爬行动物的化石
例句：Marine sponges have a long fossil record (= their development has been recorded over a long period ) .
海绵动物留下了漫长的化石记录。

skull
音标：英 /skʌl/  美 /skʌl/
n. 头盖骨
例句：Her husband was later treated for a fractured skull.
她丈夫后来因颅骨碎裂而接受治疗。

outraged
音标：英 /'autreidʒid/  美 /'autreidʒid/
adj. 暴怒的
例句：Every few months, I receive an e-mail from an outraged (usually white) reader who is dismayed by what she sees as the denigration of my work.
每隔几个月，我便会收到一封来自愤怒读者（通常是白人）的电子邮件，对于她认为我的作品遭到的诋毁感到愤忾。
例句：And outraged, nauseous, flabbergasted ... I wish I could say I can't imagine what they were thinking, but in fact I do have a guess.
我感到受了伤害，并且愤怒、恶心、震惊······ 我但愿自己能说无法想像出他们的想法，但事实上我有一个猜想。
例句：Greeks have turned out in droves to a series of nationwide protests against the economy and austerity measures, outraged that they are being asked to make more sacrifices.
希腊人举行了一系列针对经济状况和紧缩措施的大规模抗议，他们对政府要求自己做出更多牺牲感到愤怒。

bizarre
音标：英 /bɪ'zɑː/  美 /bɪ'zɑr/
adj. 奇怪的
例句：a bizarre coincidence
奇怪的巧合
例句：dancers in rather bizarre costumes
身着奇装异服的舞者

consensus
音标：英 /kən'sensəs/  美 /kən'sɛnsəs/
n. 共识，一致
短语：reach a consensus — 达成共识
例句：The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。
例句：the current consensus of opinion
目前观点上的一致
例句：The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
大家都认为科技是好东西。
例句：the consensus politics of the fifties
50年代的共识政治

obedience
音标：英 /ə'biːdɪəns/  美 /ə'bidjəns/
n. 顺从，服从
短语：in obedience to — 遵照
短语：passive obedience — 被动性服从，绝对服从
例句：obedience classes for dogs and their owners
为狗和主人安排的服从训练课

nurture
音标：英 /'nɜːtʃə/  美 /'nɝtʃɚ/
v. 培养
短语：nature and nurture — 先天与后天，遗传与环境；先天遗传说和后天培养说
例句：European union is an ideal that has been nurtured since the post-war years.
建立欧盟是战后多年来人们一直争取实现的理想。
例句：a hatred of foreigners nurtured by the media
由媒体助长的对外国人的仇恨

allocate
音标：英 /'æləkeɪt/  美 /'æləket/
v. 分配
短语：allocate funds — 拨款；分配资金
短语：allocate for — 为…而分配；把…拨给
例句：Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

deteriorating
音标：英 /dɪ'tɪrɪə,retin/  美 /dɪ'tɪrɪə,retɪŋ/
adj. 恶化的
例句：But in many ways the picture in Washington may be deteriorating.
但是在华盛顿，许多方面的情况可能是在恶化。
例句：In my point of view, we are in a prime time to curb the problem from deteriorating.
我认为，现在已经到了控制这个问题进一步恶化的成熟时机。
例句：If you raise the issue of your father's deteriorating health and he changes the subject, you can try to gently raise it again, without pressuring him.
如果你向父亲提出了他健康恶化的问题，而他却改变了话题，你可以试着温和的再次把问题提出来，而不要强迫他。

predisposition
音标：英 /priːdɪspə'zɪʃn/  美 /'pridɪspə'zɪʃən/
n. 倾向
短语：genetic predisposition — 遗传素质
例句：There is a thin dividing line between educating the public and creating a predisposition to panic.
教育公众和营造恐慌倾向之间只有细小的区别。
